name: Pamela Sarms
source:
Human priestess.

The bishop of the "Zerchion" cult, headquartered in Schutral city and expanding its influence outwards. Appearance-wise she looks the oldest, her measured demeanour gives others the sense of calmness befitting her age and an air of tolerance. Her mature body with its sensuous voluptuousness conveys an adult sex appeal despite her priestess vocation.

She usually speaks with a gentle and calm voice befitting a bishop, however she never betrays her innermost thoughts.

[Spoiler] She approaches Gil's party shortly after they arrive at Schutral. She attempts to commission them to assassinate Loretta, but she is rejected as they do not wish to get involved in the city's internecine politics. She wins over Gil eventually using sex, but the party also learns that the cult she is a member of has a poor reputation both within and without the city. 

Although Pamela herself is a decent person wishing to do good for the city through Loretta's assassination, the archbishop she is blindly devoted to turns out to be possessed by the demon sent by Zenohemia to monitor Loretta. After learning the truth, she resolves to join Gil's party as she becomes convinced Gil is the messenger of God and that working with him is to abet His will.

Born with a unusually strong libido, Pamela is grateful the church of Lasfarr has a tolerant attitude towards sex. She has no qualms in offering her body to those who desire her, believing this act to be the greatest expression of love embodied by her religion.

She is the only member in Gil's party capable of exorcising demons if Gil chooses not to use his Tome. One advantage she has over Gil is the ability to handle many victims at once, although this costs money to buy the required materials for mass exorcism and is very draining on Pamela spiritually. Regardless, she will choose exorcism over execution no matter how evil the possessed person was, like the Witches who now fight alongside Gilbert she believes every person deserves a chance at atonement and salvation. [/Spoiler]
